KeepAliveInterval.description: HTTP/2 PING frame interval (e.g. `20s`), empty for no keepalive.

KeepAliveTimeout.description: HTTP/2 PING timeout (e.g. `10s`), empty for no timeout.

KeepAliveWhileIdle.description:
Send HTTP/2 keepalive PINGs even when idle; spelled like `AllowUnsafeConnection`,
empty for false.

MaxHeaderListSize.description: HTTP/2 max header list size in bytes, empty for no limit.

IdentitySource.description: Where the client's TLS identity comes from.

oneOf.description: A certificate and its key, each in its own PEM file.

CertPem.description:
Path to the certificate file, in PEM format, the leaf first and any chain after
it.

KeyPem.description: Path to the key file, in PEM format.

oneOf.description: A certificate and its key bundled together in one PKCS#12 file.

CertP12.description: Path to the PKCS#12 bundle. Any intermediates it carries are kept, leaf first.

CertP12Password.description: The password protecting the bundle, absent for none.

ProxyConfig.description: Configuration of the HTTP proxy used to reach the endpoint.

Password.description:
Password for proxy authentication; empty falls back to the password the proxy URL
carried, independently of the username.

Source.description:
Where to find the proxy: empty or `system` to follow the environment, `none` for a
direct connection, otherwise the proxy URL, whose scheme has to be `http`.

Username.description:
Username for proxy authentication; empty falls back to the username the proxy URL
carried, if any.

Keepalive.description: TCP keepalive duration (e.g. `30s`), empty for no keepalive.

KeepaliveInterval.description: Interval between TCP keepalive probes (e.g. `5s`), empty for the OS default.

KeepaliveRetries.description: Number of TCP keepalive retries, empty for the OS default.

NagleAlgorithm.description:
Enable Nagle's algorithm (disable TCP_NODELAY); spelled like `AllowUnsafeConnection`,
empty for false.

TlsConfig.description: TLS and mTLS: the client's own identity, the server's CA, and SSL verification behaviour.

AllowUnsafeConnection.description:
Accept any server certificate instead of verifying it: `1`, `true`, `yes`, `enable`,
`allow` or `authorize`, and their negatives; empty for false.

CaCert.description: Path to the Certificate Authority file, in PEM format; absent for the system CAs.

Identity.description: TLS identity of the client, absent for no client authentication.

OverrideTargetName.description: Override the endpoint name during SSL verification.

description: Options for creating a gRPC client.

ConnectTimeout.description: Timeout for establishing a connection to the server (e.g. `30s`), defaults to 60s.

Proxy.description: HTTP proxy used to reach the endpoint, defaults to following the environment.

RateLimit.description:
Rate limit for requests, written `count/duration` (e.g. `100/1s`), defaults to no rate
limit.

Timeout.description: Timeout for each request (e.g. `30s`), defaults to no timeout.

Tls.description:
TLS and mTLS: the client's own identity, the server's CA, and SSL verification
behaviour.

UserAgent.description: User-Agent header value sent with each request.
